articles.title: Fire Alarm Delay Can't Stop a Record-Smashing Swim Morning!
articles.summary: A fire alarm made swimmers wait 30 extra minutes, but then Gabi Brito zoomed to a new meet record in the 50 fly at the Junior Pan Pacs in Vancouver. Her time: 26.45 seconds!

articles.title: Rock Star Reunion: Guitar Hero Plays with His Old Band After 40 Years!
articles.summary: Ritchie Blackmore, the famous guitarist, surprised everyone by playing 'Smoke on the Water' with Deep Purple for the first time in 40 years. He said it felt like old friends meeting again.

articles.title: Welcome to Argentina: Land of Gauchos, Giant Waterfalls, and Soccer Fever!
articles.summary: Argentina is a huge country in South America, about one-third the size of the U.S. It has cowboys called gauchos, the amazing Iguazú Falls, and more than half the people live near Buenos Aires.
